"""Independent exact archive/index/commit scope audit; this does not run Lean.

The checkpoint baseline is fixed, but accepted counts are reconstructed from
actual terminal receipts and current exact source bytes. Nothing is staged.
"""
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import argparse
import ast
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
STATE = ROOT / '.lake/proof-continuation'
DEST = ROOT / 'verification/proof-continuation/2026-10-15'
PREFIX = DEST.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() + '/'
BASELINE = '0533da3652a805ec8fef532616b05299f0efb4cb'
REPORT = 'docs/PROOF_CONTINUATION_2026-10-15.md'
PINS = ('lean-toolchain', 'lakefile.toml', 'lake-manifest.json')
MUTABLE_ARCHIVE = {'unaccepted-candidates.json', 'metadata/census-scope.json'}
PARSER = argparse.ArgumentParser()
MODE = PARSER.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
MODE.add_argument('--commit')
MODE.add_argument('--archive-only', action='store_true')
ARGS = PARSER.parse_args()


def git(*arguments):
    return subprocess.check_output(
        ['git', '-c', 'core.autocrlf=false', *arguments], cwd=ROOT)


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))


def relative(name):
    p = PurePosixPath(name)
    assert name and not p.is_absolute() and '..' not in p.parts, name
    assert p.as_posix() == name and '\\' not in name, name
    return name


def literal_catalog(name, variable):
    """Read only explicit catalog entries, without executing a helper."""
    tree = ast.parse((STATE / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    found = []
    for item in tree.body:
        if isinstance(item, ast.Assign) and any(
                isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == variable
                for target in item.targets):
            if isinstance(item.value, (ast.List, ast.Dict)):
                value = ast.literal_eval(item.value)
                found.extend(value.keys() if isinstance(value, dict) else value)
        if variable == 'CANDIDATES' and isinstance(item, ast.For) and \
                isinstance(item.iter, ast.Tuple):
            found.extend(ast.literal_eval(item.iter))
    assert found and len(found) == len(set(found)), (name, 'bad literal catalog')
    assert all(isinstance(module, str) and module.startswith('ImbalancedChen.')
               for module in found), name
    return set(found)


assert git('branch', '--show-current').decode().strip() == \
    'codex/proof-continuation-20261015'
assert git('merge-base', '--is-ancestor', BASELINE, 'HEAD') == b''
MANIFEST = load(DEST / 'manifest.json')
CANDIDATES = load(DEST / 'unaccepted-candidates.json')
OLD = json.loads(git('show', BASELINE + ':' + PREFIX + 'manifest.json'))
assert len(OLD['modules']) == 155 and OLD['declaration_count'] == 3529
assert MANIFEST['schema'] == 'proof-continuation-owned-evidence-v1'
assert MANIFEST['baseline'] == OLD['baseline']
assert MANIFEST['manuscript'] == OLD['manuscript'] == \
    'ba6ec11d800eccc54406490631895e174de85766'
assert not any(MANIFEST[key] for key in (
    'main_theorem_proved', 'aggregate_build_claimed', 'external_closure_replay_claimed'))
assert not CANDIDATES['main_theorem_proved']
assert set(OLD['modules']) <= set(MANIFEST['modules'])
assert not set(MANIFEST['modules']) & set(CANDIDATES['candidates'])
for module, entry in OLD['modules'].items():
    assert MANIFEST['modules'][module]['source_sha256'] == entry['source_sha256'], module
    assert MANIFEST['modules'][module]['declarations'] == entry['declarations'], module

OWNED_CATALOG = literal_catalog('export_verified_batch.py', 'MODULES')
CANDIDATE_CATALOG = literal_catalog('export_candidates.py', 'CANDIDATES')
assert set(MANIFEST['modules']) <= OWNED_CATALOG
assert set(CANDIDATES['candidates']) <= CANDIDATE_CATALOG
# New exact-scope acceptance after the former pending-High exclusion.
# Every required source also passes the complete independent receipt checks below.
REQUIRED_NEW = {'ImbalancedChen.ActualPrimeBoxTestFunctions': ('2f2bee793b8d5054999bd0e71532f1f07ecf4ba69ba6cf98a0f840e4403e1203', 27), 'ImbalancedChen.CurrentChenUniformEulerNormalization': ('ad3ba7aa52cc7e667823621810b36eb744c5fc5985e41d1a51d03281a2a254e7', 3), 'ImbalancedChen.FirstExitValidSelection': ('ac65228de387c57af2c53dbea7e16d6b457f042ec145800ce90e96229030f232', 11), 'ImbalancedChen.Part3LichtmanSignedDifferenceMultiplicity': ('0f41b856a9f52fa9618f0a10538e9b4cdfd46b3c1c795323da11727b5a92632f', 95), 'ImbalancedChen.Part3SharedFirstFactorSmallCoreFourierTruncation': ('14e7d51db4f2b507dc06ff16d16f1d1c34479a7b9c090b7a12615aa089af5a02', 33), 'ImbalancedChen.Part3SharedFirstFactorSmallCorePrimeDifferenceReindex': ('11f1d6e2b8d27a5e1c93eba1f65cbe2f669f33a63f4d6a1b945e60ac9bd4c5bd', 7)}
assert len(MANIFEST["modules"]) == 161 and MANIFEST["declaration_count"] == 3705
assert set(MANIFEST["modules"]) - set(OLD["modules"]) == set(REQUIRED_NEW)
for module, (digest, count) in REQUIRED_NEW.items():
    assert MANIFEST["modules"][module]["source_sha256"] == digest, module
    assert MANIFEST["modules"][module]["declarations"] == count, module
RECORDS = {**MANIFEST['modules'], **CANDIDATES['candidates']}
SOURCES = {}
for module, entry in RECORDS.items():
    name = relative(module.replace('.', '/') + '.lean')
    assert sha((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) == entry['source_sha256'], name
    SOURCES[name] = entry['source_sha256']

# Independently reconstruct exact-current-source eligible owned records. This
# checks the exported inventory, without pretending terminal receipts are a
# new kernel replay or independent replay of the entire imported closure.
CURRENT = {module: sha((ROOT / (module.replace('.', '/') + '.lean')).read_bytes())
           for module in OWNED_CATALOG
           if (ROOT / (module.replace('.', '/') + '.lean')).is_file()}
ELIGIBLE = {}
for path in sorted((STATE / 'audits').glob('*/receipt.json')):
    receipt = load(path)
    if receipt.get('status') != 'PASS_OWNED_REPLAY_AND_COMPLETE_TYPES_AXIOMS':
        continue
    targets = receipt['targets']
    if not targets or any(CURRENT.get(module) != digest
                          for module, digest in targets.items()):
        continue
    assert receipt['inputs_before'] == receipt['inputs_after'], str(path)
    assert not receipt['external_closure_replay_claimed']
    assert not receipt['unconditional_main_claimed']
    for module, digest in targets.items():
        ELIGIBLE[module] = (digest, receipt['declaration_counts'][module], path)
assert set(ELIGIBLE) == set(MANIFEST['modules']), \
    ('owned census mismatch', sorted(set(ELIGIBLE) ^ set(MANIFEST['modules'])))
assert all(isinstance(entry['declarations'], int) and entry['declarations'] > 0
           for entry in MANIFEST['modules'].values())
assert sum(entry['declarations'] for entry in MANIFEST['modules'].values()) == \
    MANIFEST['declaration_count']

for module, entry in MANIFEST['modules'].items():
    digest, count, original = ELIGIBLE[module]
    assert digest == entry['source_sha256'] and count == entry['declarations'], module
    audit_name, compile_name = relative(entry['audit']), relative(entry['compile'])
    assert audit_name.startswith('audits/') and compile_name.startswith('compilation/')
    assert audit_name in MANIFEST['files'] and compile_name in MANIFEST['files']
    audit, compilation = load(DEST / audit_name), load(DEST / compile_name)
    assert (DEST / audit_name).read_bytes() == original.read_bytes(), module
    assert audit['status'] == 'PASS_OWNED_REPLAY_AND_COMPLETE_TYPES_AXIOMS'
    assert audit['targets'][module] == digest
    assert audit['declaration_counts'][module] == count
    assert audit['inputs_before'] == audit['inputs_after']
    assert compilation['status'] == 'PASS' and compilation['exit_code'] == 0
    assert compilation['warnings_as_errors']
    assert compilation['module'] == module
    assert compilation['binding'] == compilation['binding_after']
    assert compilation['binding']['source_sha256'] == digest
    assert compilation['object_parts'] == entry['object_parts'] == \
        entry['audited_object_parts'] == audit['inputs_before']['owned_object_parts'][module]
    assert compilation['binding']['pins'] == entry['audited_pins'] == \
        audit['inputs_before']['pins']
    assert compilation['binding']['lean_real_sha256'] == \
        entry['audited_lean_real_sha256'] == audit['inputs_before']['lean_real_sha256']

ACTUAL = {p.relative_to(DEST).as_posix() for p in DEST.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
assert ACTUAL == set(MANIFEST['files']) | {'manifest.json'}, \
    ('archive file census mismatch', sorted(ACTUAL ^ (set(MANIFEST['files']) | {'manifest.json'})))
EXPECTED = dict(SOURCES)
ORIGINALS = 0
for name, digest in MANIFEST['files'].items():
    relative(name)
    data = (DEST / name).read_bytes()
    assert sha(data) == digest, name
    if name in OLD['files'] and name not in MUTABLE_ARCHIVE:
        assert digest == OLD['files'][name], ('old evidence changed', name)
    first, *tail = PurePosixPath(name).parts
    if first in ('audits', 'compilation', 'unaccepted-attempts'):
        directory = 'audits' if first == 'audits' else 'runs'
        original = STATE.joinpath(directory, *tail)
        assert original.is_file() and data == original.read_bytes(), name
        ORIGINALS += 1
    EXPECTED[PREFIX + name] = digest
assert set(OLD['files']) <= set(MANIFEST['files']), 'Original evidence disappeared'
METADATA = load(DEST / 'metadata/census-scope.json')
assert not METADATA['inherited_cache_promoted']
for record in METADATA['compressed_originals']:
    archive = relative(record['archive'])
    data = (DEST / archive).read_bytes()
    assert sha(data) == record['compressed_sha256']
    with gzip.open(DEST / archive, 'rb') as stream:
        decoded = stream.read()
    assert sha(decoded) == record['original_sha256']
    assert len(decoded) == record['original_bytes']
    original = STATE / relative(record['original_relative_path'])
    assert decoded == original.read_bytes(), record['original_relative_path']
EXPECTED[PREFIX + 'manifest.json'] = sha((DEST / 'manifest.json').read_bytes())
EXPECTED[REPORT] = sha((ROOT / REPORT).read_bytes())
for name in PINS:
    data = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
    assert data == git('show', BASELINE + ':' + name), name
    assert data == (DEST / 'pins' / name).read_bytes(), name
    EXPECTED[name] = sha(data)

ATTRIBUTES = (ROOT / '.gitattributes').read_bytes()
OLD_ATTRIBUTES = git('show', BASELINE + ':.gitattributes')
assert ATTRIBUTES.startswith(OLD_ATTRIBUTES)
ADDED = ATTRIBUTES[len(OLD_ATTRIBUTES):].splitlines()
assert all(line.endswith(b' -text') and line[:-6].decode('utf-8') in SOURCES
           for line in ADDED), ADDED
assert len(ADDED) == len(set(ADDED))
assert not any(line in set(OLD_ATTRIBUTES.splitlines()) for line in ADDED)
EXPECTED['.gitattributes'] = sha(ATTRIBUTES)

CHANGED = []
BLOBS = 0
if not ARGS.archive_only:
    # The root owner stages separately with the explicit staging helper. Here
    # every path is checked again from original bytes, before any commit/push.
    for source in SOURCES:
        assert (source + ' -text').encode() in ATTRIBUTES.splitlines(), source
    if ARGS.commit:
        ref = ARGS.commit
        assert git('rev-parse', ref + '^').decode().strip() == BASELINE
        changed = git('diff-tree', '--no-commit-id', '--name-only', '-r', '-z', ref)
    else:
        ref = ''
        assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == BASELINE
        changed = git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only', '-z')
    CHANGED = [path for path in changed.decode('utf-8').split('\0') if path]
    assert all(path in SOURCES or path in (REPORT, '.gitattributes') or
               (path.startswith(PREFIX) and path in EXPECTED) for path in CHANGED), CHANGED
    assert not any(path.startswith(('.github/', 'automations/')) for path in CHANGED)
    names = sorted(EXPECTED)
    requests = ''.join((ref + ':' + name if ref else ':' + name) + '\n' for name in names)
    process = subprocess.run(['git', 'cat-file', '--batch'], input=requests.encode(),
                             capture_output=True, cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    data, position = process.stdout, 0
    for name in names:
        end = data.index(b'\n', position)
        fields = data[position:end].split()
        assert len(fields) == 3 and fields[1] == b'blob', (name, fields)
        size = int(fields[2])
        content = data[end + 1:end + 1 + size]
        assert sha(content) == EXPECTED[name], name
        assert sha((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) == EXPECTED[name], name
        assert data[end + 1 + size:end + 2 + size] == b'\n'
        position = end + 2 + size
    assert position == len(data)
    BLOBS = len(names)

RESULT = dict(
    scope='INDEPENDENT_EXPLICIT_SCOPE_ARCHIVE_ALL_BLOBS_AND_PINS', passed=True,
    reference=ARGS.commit or ('WORKTREE_ARCHIVE' if ARGS.archive_only else 'INDEX'),
    baseline=BASELINE, changed_paths=len(CHANGED), verified_blobs=BLOBS,
    archived_files=len(MANIFEST['files']), original_receipt_log_and_type_files=ORIGINALS,
    accepted_modules=len(MANIFEST['modules']), owned_declarations=MANIFEST['declaration_count'],
    unaccepted_candidates=len(CANDIDATES['candidates']),
    attributes_exact_task_source_rules_appended=len(ADDED), main_theorem_proved=False,
    aggregate_build_claimed=False, external_closure_replay_claimed=False)
kind = 'commit' if ARGS.commit else ('archive' if ARGS.archive_only else 'index')
output = Path(__file__).with_name('20261021-after0533-161-' + kind + '-independent-check.json')
output.write_text(json.dumps(RESULT, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps(RESULT))
proof_scope: Integrity archive/index/commit allblobs only, not a new Lean replay or main theorem proof.
